description: The contact sheets, newest first: the order here is the order on the site. Each lists its frames (photos.json ids, each on exactly one sheet) and the circled ones, at most four; only a circled frame can hang on a wall. kind: a walk, a day in one place, a trip or a series, or 'between' for the single photographs of one month that belong to no walk. address, if given, is the sheet's page (/photography/sheets/<address>/); previous_addresses forward to it. retired holds addresses that must keep working after a sheet or a photograph was removed: a sheet address forwards to the contact sheets, a photograph to the sheet it was on. Read by tools/build-photography.py.
